questions.question: Renowned sculptor Ram Vanji Sutar, creator of the 182-metre Statue of Unity, passed away in Uttar Pradesh at the age of 100 due to age-related ailments. Which state government conferred upon him its highest civilian honour?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Eminent sculptor Ram Vanji Sutar, creator of the Statue of Unity, passed away at the age of 100.**
 
• **He died at his residence in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, following age-related illnesses.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Ram Vanji Sutar was conferred the Maharashtra Bhushan Award.**
 
• **The award is the highest civilian honour of the Maharashtra government.**
 
• **The honour was presented by Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis and Deputy CMs.**
 
• **Sutar was globally renowned for sculpting the 182-metre Statue of Unity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Maharashtra Bhushan Award**__ – The highest civilian award of the Government of Maharashtra.
 
• Ram Vanji Sutar was a gold medallist from J.J. School of Art, Bombay.
 
• He is known for over 450 busts of Mahatma Gandhi installed worldwide.
 
• His works in bronze and realistic sculpture earned global acclaim.

questions.question: Which country secured the 3rd position overall in the Asia Power Index (API) 2025, with a power score of 40.0?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**India.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India secured the 3rd position in the Asia Power Index (API) 2025 with a power score of 40.0 out of 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The API 2025 ranks countries based on indicators such as economic strength, military capability, and cultural influence.**
 
• **India’s score of 40.0 marks the first time it crossed the 40-point threshold, earning it the status of a “Major Power” in Asia.**
 
• **The United States and China secured the top two spots, with India following as a significant regional power.**
 
• **The index is based on 131 indicators across eight thematic areas, assessing influence in the Indo-Pacific region.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Asia Power Index__

 __
 
• The API 2025 ranks countries in the Indo-Pacific based on factors such as economic strength, military capabilities, and diplomacy.
 
• The index uses 131 quantitative and qualitative indicators across eight thematic areas to evaluate a nation's regional influence.
 
 
 
• India’s Rise as a Major Power__
 __
 
• India’s position as a Major Power is marked by a substantial rise in its power score, reflecting its growing influence in the region.
 
• The 40.0 score places India firmly behind superpowers USA and China, underscoring its importance in shaping regional dynamics.
 
 
 
• Top Five Countries in API 2025__
 
 
• The United States and China remain the top two superpowers, followed by India in third place as a Major Power.
 
• Japan and Russia occupy the positions of Middle Powers, with notable but less dominant influence in the region.

questions.question: Indian PM Narendra Modi has been conferred with the Order of Oman award for his exceptional contribution to India–Omani relations. What are the capital and currency of Oman?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Muscat and Omani Rial.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred the Order of Oman by Sultan Haitham bin Tariq.**
 
• **The honour recognises his contribution to strengthening India–Oman relations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The capital of Oman is Muscat.**
 
• **The official currency of Oman is the Omani Rial.**
 
• **The Order of Oman was established in 1970 by Sultan Qaboos bin Said.**
 
• **The award was conferred during the completion of 70 years of India–Oman diplomatic relations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Oman’s coastline lies along the Arabian Sea and the Gulf of Oman.
 
• The Order of Oman is awarded to select global leaders for contributions to public life and bilateral relations.

questions.question: Which wetland has been declared Chhattisgarh’s first Ramsar Site, marking a major environmental milestone for the state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kopra Reservoir.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Kopra Reservoir in Bilaspur district has been declared Chhattisgarh’s first Ramsar Site under the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Kopra Reservoir is a freshwater wetland shaped by both natural processes and human-made structures.**
 
• **The reservoir is primarily rain-fed and supported by small seasonal streams.**
 
• **It functions as a vital water body in a semi-rural landscape, supporting livelihoods and ecological balance.**
 
• **Its hydrological and ecological significance qualified it for Ramsar recognition.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Ramsar Convention on Wetlands__

 __
 
• An international treaty for the conservation and sustainable use of wetlands.
 
• Recognises wetlands of international importance, especially as habitats for biodiversity.
 
• Encourages wise use of wetlands through national action and international cooperation.
 
 
 
• Ecological Importance of Kopra Reservoir__
 __
 
• Acts as an ecological hotspot supporting regional biodiversity.
 
• Enhances environmental resilience in the Bilaspur region.
 
• Plays a role beyond water storage, contributing to ecosystem stability.
 
 
 
• Significance for Chhattisgarh__
 
 
• First Ramsar-listed wetland for the state.
 
• Strengthens Chhattisgarh’s presence in national and global wetland conservation efforts.
 
• Highlights the importance of semi-rural freshwater ecosystems.

questions.question: As of December 2025, the Centre has disbursed over ₹4 lakh crore through 21 instalments since the inception of the PM-KISAN scheme. What type of scheme is PM-KISAN, and how much annual support is provided per eligible farmer family?

options.text: A centrally sponsored scheme; ₹4,000 per year

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A central sector scheme; ₹6,000 per year.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Centre has disbursed over ₹4 lakh crore under the PM-KISAN scheme through 21 installments since its launch.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **PM-KISAN is a Central Sector Scheme__ launched on 24 February 2019.**
 
• **Provides direct income support of __₹6,000 annually__ per eligible farmer family.**
 
• **The amount is paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 each every four months.**
 
• **Funds are transferred directly to Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts via DBT.**
 
• **Over 11 crore farmer families have benefited so far, with more than 25% being women farmers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Eligibility**__

 __
 
• Farmers must have cultivable land in their name verified through state land records.
 
• Must complete e-KYC and provide correct bank details.
 
• Exclusions: institutional landholders, high-income professionals, and government employees.
 
 
 
• **Recent Installments**__
 __
 
• 21st installment released on 19 November 2025 from Coimbatore: ~₹18,000 crore to ~9 crore farmers.
 
• 20th installment released on 2 August 2025 from Varanasi: ~₹20,500 crore to 9.7 crore beneficiaries.
 
 
 
• **Access**__
 
 
• Farmers can register or check status via **pmkisan.gov.in**, CSCs, and PACS.
 
• Digital tools like e-KYC and the PM-KISAN portal ensure transparent verification and timely transfers.

questions.question: Which railway station received the National Energy Conservation Award 2025 as the Best Performing Unit in the Transport Category (Railway Station)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Miyana Railway Station, Madhya Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Miyana Railway Station in Guna district, Madhya Pradesh, received the National Energy Conservation Award 2025 on National Energy Conservation Day.**

__
 
• The **National Energy Conservation Award 2025** was presented to Miyana Railway Station.

 __

• Promotes efficient use of energy across sectors.
 
• Implements policies for sustainable energy management.

• BLDC fans consume significantly less electricity than conventional fans.
 
• Smart lighting systems optimize energy use through automated controls.

questions.question: Which state became the first in India to achieve 100% digitisation of voter rolls under the Special Intensive Revision (SIR)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan has become the first state in India to digitise 100% of its voter rolls under SIR.**
 
• **The milestone was announced by Chief Electoral Officer Navin Mahajan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajasthan completed full digitisation of electoral rolls.**
 
• It leads the country in voter mapping with over 97% completion.
 
• This reduces documentation requirements during claims-objections phase.
 
• Draft electoral roll publication scheduled for December 16.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **SIR**__ – Special Intensive Revision, a large-scale voter roll verification and update process.
 
• High-quality mapping improved transparency and reduced repeat verification.
 
• Approximately only 30 voters per booth may need to submit documents.
 
• BLOs, panchayat staff, and officers played a key role in execution.

questions.question: Which state reported the highest number of complaints under the Jal Jeevan Mission?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Uttar Pradesh reported the highest number of complaints, constituting 84% of the total complaints under the Jal Jeevan Mission, mainly concerning financial irregularities and poor-quality work.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) aims to provide Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to every rural household with 55 litres per capita per day (lpcd) of potable water.**
 
• **Launched in 2019, JJM is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme, with the Department of Drinking Water & Sanitation (DDWS) under the Ministry of Jal Shakti as the nodal ministry.**
 
• **The mission is part of the restructured National Rural Drinking Water Programme (NRDWP), which was subsumed into JJM.**
 
• **Uttar Pradesh’s complaints were related to financial irregularities and poor execution under the mission, highlighting significant implementation issues.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Funding Pattern of JJM**__

 __
 
• 90:10 (Himalayan States and North-Eastern States).
 
• 100% funding for Union Territories.
 
• 50:50 for other states.
 
 
 
• **Progress of Jal Jeevan Mission**__
 __
 
• Increased access to tap water in rural India from 16.7% (3.23 crore households) to an additional 12.48 crore households connected.
 
• Focus on providing potable water to every rural household by ensuring FHTCs.
 
 
 
• **Background and Objective**__
 
 
• JJM aims to ensure potable water to every rural household through tap connections.
 
• Ensures 55 litres of water per capita per day, addressing both quality and quantity issues.

questions.question: Which state won the first prize among states in Group 1 for energy efficiency at the National Energy Conservation Awards (NECA) 2025?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

questions.question: Which Indian city has unveiled a 70-foot iron statue of Lionel Messi, believed to be the largest statue of the footballer in the world?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Kolkata unveiled a 70-foot iron statue of Lionel Messi at Lake Town, South Dum Dum, created by the Sree Bhumi Sporting Club.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The statue is believed to be the largest iron statue of Lionel Messi in the world, standing 70 feet tall.**
 
• **It has been installed at Lake Town, South Dum Dum, a football-loving locality in Kolkata.**
 
• **The project was executed by the Sree Bhumi Sporting Club, reflecting Kolkata’s deep football culture.**
 
• **Lionel Messi will virtually inaugurate the statue, giving the tribute global recognition.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Kolkata and Football__

 __
 
• Kolkata is widely regarded as the football capital of India.
 
• The city has a historic rivalry between clubs like Mohun Bagan and East Bengal.
 
• Football fandom in Kolkata extends strongly to global icons and international teams.
 
 
 
• Global Football Icons in Kolkata__
 __
 
• Legendary footballers such as Diego Maradona, Ronaldinho Gaucho, and Emiliano Martinez have visited the city.

questions.question: The term “OncoMark” was recently in the news. What does it refer to?

questions.question: What is the theme of World Soil Day (WSD) 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Healthy Soils for Healthy Cities**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **World Soil Day (WSD) 2025 focuses on the theme “Healthy Soils for Healthy Cities,” urging citizens and governments to reconsider the role of soil in urban environments.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The theme emphasizes the importance of soil health in cities and calls for sustainable soil management practices in urban settings.**
 
• **World Soil Day is celebrated annually on December 5 to highlight the vital role of soil in supporting life on Earth.**
 
• **The day was first proposed in 2002 by the International Union of Soil Sciences (IUSS) and has been celebrated officially since 2014.**
 
• **WSD 2025 encourages citizens, urban planners, and governments to rethink how soil can contribute to creating healthier cities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **History of World Soil Day**__

 __
 
• First proposed in 2002 by the International Union of Soil Sciences (IUSS).
 
• Supported by Thailand and promoted by the Global Soil Partnership under FAO.
 
• Officially recognized by the UN General Assembly in 2013, with the first celebration held in 2014.
 
 
 
• **WSD’s Significance**__
 __
 
• Raises awareness about the essential role of soil in maintaining ecosystems, agriculture, and water resources.
 
• Encourages sustainable soil management practices to combat soil degradation, which affects biodiversity, food security, and climate resilience.
 
 
 
• **Focus on Urban Soils**__
 
 
• This year’s theme “Healthy Soils for Healthy Cities” underscores the importance of soil health in urban planning and development.
 
• Highlights the need for innovative solutions to ensure sustainable and fertile soil in urban environments.

questions.question: What is the key feature of the Indian Navy’s Maritime Doctrine 2025?

options.text: It focuses solely on naval combat strategies
It introduces "no-war, no-peace" as a distinct operational category
It excludes joint operations with other forces

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**It introduces "no-war, no-peace" as a distinct operational category**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Indian Navy’s Maritime Doctrine 2025, released by Admiral Dinesh Tripathi, is the apex guidance document for naval strategy and operations.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **First released in 2004, revised in 2009, and amended in 2015, the doctrine reflects major shifts in India’s maritime environment and strategic outlook.**
 
• **The 2025 update formally recognises “no-war, no-peace” as an operational category, addressing modern grey-zone maritime challenges like coercion and hybrid tactics.**
 
• **The doctrine emphasises joint operations by aligning with tri-service joint doctrines to ensure interoperability across all branches of the armed forces.**
 
• **It serves as the guiding framework for the Navy's roles, strategies, and employment in both peace and conflict scenarios.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **“No-war, No-peace” Operational Category**__

 __
 
• Introduced to address the growing importance of grey-zone tactics in modern warfare.
 
• Reflects challenges like coercion, hybrid warfare, and geopolitical tensions short of full-scale war.
 
 
 
• **Emphasis on Jointmanship**__
 __
 
• The doctrine aligns with tri-service joint doctrines to ensure effective interoperability.
 
• Promotes collaborative defense efforts across the Indian Armed Forces.
 
 
 
• **India’s Maritime Strategy**__
 __
 
• Guides naval strategy in a rapidly evolving maritime security environment.
 
• Addresses the changing nature of threats and the strategic importance of the Indian Ocean region.
 
 
 
• **Key Shifts in the Doctrine**__
 
 
• Reflects India’s evolving strategic outlook and maritime priorities over the last decade.
 
• Emphasises adaptation to modern geopolitical and technological changes in global maritime security.

questions.question: Who was sworn in as the new Chief Information Commissioner (CIC) of India in December 2025?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Raj Kumar Goyal.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Raj Kumar Goyal has been sworn in as the Chief Information Commissioner of India at Rashtrapati Bhavan, with President Droupadi Murmu administering the oath.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Goyal is a retired 1990-batch IAS officer of the AGMUT cadre and has previously served as Secretary in the Ministry of Law and Justice and Home Ministry.**
 
• **His appointment was recommended by a three-member committee headed by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.**
 
• **The CIC post had been vacant since former CIC Heeralal Samariya demitted office in September 2025.**
 
• **With his appointment, the Central Information Commission regains leadership and is expected to return to near full strength with new Information Commissioners.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Central Information Commission (CIC)**__

 __
 
• A statutory body established under the Right to Information Act, 2005, to address complaints from individuals unable to obtain information from public authorities.
 
• Comprises one Chief Information Commissioner and up to ten Information Commissioners, appointed by the President on the recommendation of a committee.
 
 
 
• **Oath of Office**__
 __
 
• The oath to the CIC is administered by the President of India.
 
• President Droupadi Murmu administered the oath to Raj Kumar Goyal.
 
 
 
• **Past Women CICs**__
 __
 
• Deepak Sandhu (fourth CIC overall) and Sushma Singh (fifth CIC overall) have served as Chief Information Commissioners.
 
 
 
• **Significance**__
 
 
• Ensures smooth functioning of the Central Information Commission.
 
• Strengthens transparency and accountability under the Right to Information Act.
